author: Centralking
body:
I believe there are many issues/glitches that need to be constantly looked at and resolved here on Avicus. This happened to myself and others many times of where we decide to dedicate a time for play (Scrimmages) and the server seems to be offline. 

My suggestion on how to fix this is that staff (devs) should create a time period here on the forums, informing us on what the server is being offline for and when are the specific exact timings that it would be for at least two to three hours before.

This would help in organization for both players and the staff. I appreciate the constant updates on the server and the game play in general and it should be like this with organization. 

Thanks for looking into my suggestion, further feedback can be said by players.

replies.author: Centralking
replies.body:
I'm not only talking about Scrimmage servers, but also talking about any other servers in general. Anyways, I'm not sure if this system is being put into effect since last time it was down, there was no announcement regarding it.

There should be a way to inform all players in a clear manner. For example, there could be a tab for "Online Servers" here on forums and it gives a status on which is offline and online. If it is offline, there should be a specific reason explaining why.

This is my suggestion for a improvement in the server.

Thanks for your time
